payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW round 4 does not converge. Revision 4 closes the prior lifecycle-column, explicit claim bound, Python scalar, basic W3C syntax, and null-safe comparison findings; strict OpenSpec and work-package validation pass. Two critical contract blockers remain: JSON Schema/OpenAPI/TypeScript still accept semantically invalid envelopes that Python rejects despite the promised same-object contract, and SQL still permits required duplicated correlation fields to be JSON null paired with SQL NULL. One non-blocking TypeScript oversized-BigInt parsing nit also remains. External multi-vendor dispatch remains policy-blocked, so the safe consensus is single-reviewer and lacks cross-vendor quorum.
completed_work: Reviewed commit 16d5d20f and all revised SQL, event, OpenAPI, Python, TypeScript, design, spec, task, and package artifacts against plan-review-3.
Confirmed the prior process-health DDL, class-specific expiry, claim-generation cap, Python BIGINT fields, basic W3C syntax/non-zero checks, and named package ownership fixes are present.
Reproduced that Draft-2020-12 JSON Schema accepts a carrier whose embedded IDs disagree with trace_id/span_id while the generated Pydantic model rejects the same object.

Demonstrated that TypeScript compiles an OperationContextEnvelope containing out-of-range IDs, malformed W3C values, zero identifiers, and invalid lengths because all constrained aliases remain plain string and no composite parser is required.
Traced the remaining direct-SQL JSON-null path through key-presence checks, nullable column checks, and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM equality.
Validated the findings schema, strict OpenSpec change, TypeScript artifact compilation, work-package schema, dependency references, DAG, and lock keys.
Did not retry the prohibited external vendor dispatch; regenerated a safe single-reviewer consensus and recorded the policy constraint.

decisions.title: Outcome remains not_converged
decisions.rationale: Two directly reproduced contract paths still accept invalid cross-service correlation, and the configured PLAN_REVIEW budget has not yet been exhausted.

decisions.title: Structural schemas cannot silently substitute for semantic validation
decisions.rationale: Descriptions do not enforce cross-field equality, and plain TypeScript aliases do not enforce runtime values. The plan must either generate equivalent composite validators or state and enforce a mandatory runtime-validation boundary.

decisions.title: Null-safe equality does not imply required presence
decisions.rationale: IS NOT DISTINCT FROM intentionally considers SQL NULL equal to an extracted JSON null; explicit non-null/type predicates are still required when canonical context exists.

next_steps: PLAN_ITERATE: generate or require one composite envelope validator for every consumer; add the reproduced carrier mismatch and generation mismatch as cross-artifact tests, and reconcile D1/task 3.1 with standard JSON Schema limits.
PLAN_ITERATE: add explicit SQL non-null and JSON-type predicates for required canonical and duplicated fields, with direct-SQL JSON-null tests.
PLAN_ITERATE: cap TypeScript decimal length before regex/BigInt conversion and add an oversized digit-string guard test.
Re-run PLAN_REVIEW; external vendor quorum still requires explicit permission to share repository-derived plan details with configured vendor services.
